materials.content:
Pastel on moderately thick, white, slightly textured laid paper mounted to grey cardboard
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986 (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Dated 1918 on basis of inscription; completed after June move to New York. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Vertical pastel of rich blue and green tones in bulbous, rounded shapes.  At the bottom center rises a small yellow light-bulb shape, hooded and surrounded by greenish white and blue.  Above this symmetrically on either side of a deep blue center are two sets of large green rounded shapes that fan upwards and outwards.   In the middle is an ogre arch shape in blue, with a very dark blackish center.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
